# Regression fixtures

`profiles/` holds the four public sample profiles from the LAIVEL UP subject repo
(<https://github.com/ai-driven-dev/laivel-up>, MIT), trimmed to the JSON and
Markdown pieces the engine reads. They are a **guardrail, not a tuning target**:
thresholds are authored from the AIDD referential and domain sense, then checked
here so a change cannot silently push a known profile off its assigned level.

Assigned levels: `perceval` Red · `bohort` Blue · `leodagan` Green · `arthur` Copper.
